t396.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Isḥāq ibn Yūsuf al-Makhzūmī al-Wāsiṭī, known as al-Azraq, as trustworthy, of the ninth generation, who died in 195 aged seventy-eight.
as: Asked if al-Azraq is reliable, Aḥmad said: yes, by God, reliable.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
صحيح الحديث، صدوق، لا بأس به
Sound in hadith, truthful, nothing wrong with him.
Yaʿqūb ibn Shaybah, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكان من أعلمهم بحديث شريك هو وإسحاق الأزرق
He and Isḥāq al-Azraq were among those who knew Sharīk's hadith best.
أحمد بن علي, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكان من الثقات المأمونين، وأحد عباد الله الصالحين
He was among the reliable and trustworthy, one of God's righteous servants.
He was reliable, though he sometimes erred.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
The audition of these men, including Isḥāq, from Sharīk is sounder.
Trustworthy, agreeing with Ibn Maʿīn’s verdict.
He was reliable, though he sometimes confused things.

t4017.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mall al-Nahdī, Abū ʿUthmān, a mukhaḍram of the leading second generation, as trustworthy, firm and devout; he died in the year 95 or later, having lived 130 years or more.
as: ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان جاهليا ثقة، لقي عمر وابن مسعود، وقد أدرك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.
He lived in the pre-Islamic period and was trustworthy. He met ʿUmar and Ibn Masʿūd and lived in the Prophet’s time.
معتمر بن سليمان, quoted by al-Mizzī
كان أبو عثمان النهدي يصلي فربما صلى حتى يغشى عليه، وكان له يتامى يحضرون طعامه
He at times prayed until he fainted and had orphans who came to eat with him.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
أبو عثمان النهدي ثقة، كان عريف قومه
Abū ʿUthmān was trustworthy and served as an official of his people.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
الحافظ أبو نعيم, quoted by al-Mizzī
وكان كثير العبادة، حسن القراءة، لزم سلمان الفارسي فصحبه اثنتي عشرة سنة.
He worshipped frequently, recited well, and accompanied Salmān al-Fārisī for twelve years.
He worshipped frequently and recited well.
وكان كثير الصلاة، يصلي حتى يغشى عليه
He prayed often and would pray until he fainted.
